questions.prompt: How was Socks able to leave the garden?
choices: The side gate had a gap.
questions.answer: The side gate had a gap.
questions.evidenceText: Then Mum remembered the side gate. The latch had not dropped properly after the recycling went out. She looked at Aiden, and Aiden looked at Betty. The gap beneath it was, they all realised, just wide enough for a determined little dog.

questions.prompt: What did Betty make to help find Socks?
choices: a map of the nature reserve
a list of warm hiding spots
questions.evidenceText: Betty designed a MISSING DOG poster on her tablet in under five minutes. It had a photograph of Socks in his red harness, a clear description, and their phone number in large digits. She printed fourteen copies.

questions.prompt: Which clue best explains why Socks chose the radiator mat?
choices: He was drawn to warm spots.
questions.answer: He was drawn to warm spots.
questions.rationale: Aiden's note says Socks is drawn to warm spots, and Mrs Obi finds him beside her warm radiator, so warmth explains why he chose that mat.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: He is lying on the mat beside my warm radiator.
